about: The short slice a pull request to staging runs (UNB-208). Six bank tasks that were right on staging on 17 Nov 2026, each answered in one or two tool calls in under two minutes, on six different sites; and, since 19 Nov 2026, one search task for each of the three sites Lewis's staging criteria name (lazada.sg, carousell.sg, ticketmaster.com), which a fresh node has to learn first, so they take several calls and up to six minutes each. A slice task right on the reference that is not right on the pull request fails the check as changed, to be re-read by hand; a confident wrong answer fails it; a wall is set aside.
